name: Data Engineer
title: Data Engineer
posting:
About the role
You will build and run the batch pipelines behind our analytics platform.

Requirements
- 2+ years building data pipelines in Python and SQL
- Spark or Flink for large batch jobs
- Orchestration with Airflow, Dagster or a similar tool
- Experience with one of Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift
- Data modeling for analytics and dbt
- Docker and CI/CD
- 4+ years with Cassandra or DynamoDB

Nice to have
- Kafka or Kinesis
- Go
- Terraform
- AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda)

name: Data Analyst
title: Data Analyst
posting:

- Strong SQL and Excel
- Tableau or Power BI
- Statistics and A/B testing

Preferred

- Looker
- SSRS

name: Machine Learning Engineer
title: Machine Learning Engineer
posting:
Responsibilities
Train, ship and monitor models in production.

Qualifications
- 3-5 years of experience in machine learning
- Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn
- MLflow for experiment tracking
- Prefect for training pipelines
- XGBoost
- Docker and Kubernetes
- REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask

Bonus
- LLM and RAG systems
- Hugging Face
